 Drones attack industrial hub in Russia's Omsk – social media
 photos, video 
 24.10.2026 19:07 
 Ukrinform 
 Drones have attacked an industrial hub in the Russian city of Omsk, located more than 2,500 km from Ukraine. 
 That is according to the Telegram channel ASTRA , Ukrinform reports.
 "The Russian Defense Ministry's air defense forces continue to repel an attack by enemy drones. The adversary's UAVs have now reached the northern industrial hub. Emergency services are working at the site. Please remain calm and report any suspicious incidents by calling 112," Omsk Region Governor Vitaly Khotsenko said.
 Read also: Zelensky confirms strikes on oil refineries in Omsk and Ukhta, one more data center
